text:
Maria’s motive to integrate her fascination with history and its lessons drives the thematic structure of 'Whispers of the Past' by anchoring the narrative in the physical act of archaeological discovery. By following archaeologists uncovering an ancient civilization, she creates a literal and metaphorical bridge between eras, which allows her to explore the themes of time, continuity, and change. This structural choice illustrates her core argument that the past is not static but actively shapes the present and future, thereby transforming her personal interest in history into a broader commentary on human existence.
